events.name: LCApplicationSubmitted
events.trigger: PER-002 submits LC application via CH-008 Corporate Banking Portal or RM-assisted. SVC-006 creates ENT-036 with status = application_submitted and publishes this event. Contains the full LC application payload needed for downstream audit and credit processing.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-006). Consumed within CAP-002 by SVC-005 for facility record update. Also consumed by SVC-053 (Notification) and SVC-103 (Audit) as cross-cutting services.
events.payload_omissions: Beneficiary full name/address, goods description, HS tariff codes, and document checklist are NOT included in the event payload — they are held in ENT-036 in SVC-006. Consumers that require this detail call SVC-006 GET /lc-applications/{id}. This minimises PII/commercially sensitive data on the event bus.

consumers.action: Updates BusinessCustomer.active_lc_count. Triggers facility headroom pre-check to surface potential limit issues before formal PH-053 credit check.
Sends LC application acknowledgement with application reference to PER-002.
Creates immutable audit log entry recording LC application initiation. WORM evidence for regulatory record-keeping.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-customer strict ordering via business_customer_id partition key on topic commercial.trade-finance.
events.worm_rationale: LC application is a regulated financial commitment. Contains customer_id and financial exposure data. 7-year retention (FCA BCOBS / COBS record-keeping rules).

events.name: LCComplianceScreeningRequested
events.trigger: PH-054: SVC-006 has completed facility headroom check (PH-053) and publishes this cross-capability event to request sanctions and export control screening from SVC-051 (CAP-005). Also published when an LCAmendment (ENT-037) changes beneficiary details, goods description, or HS tariff codes (ALT-004 amendment path).
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-006). Consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-051). Crosses the CAP-002 / CAP-005 capability boundary. Exclusively async — no synchronous call to CAP-005 permitted.

payload_schema.screening_request_id: string (UUID v4) — correlation identifier for screening request/response pair
payload_schema.screening_trigger: string enum (initial_application | amendment) — distinguishes new LC vs amendment rescreening
payload_schema.amendment_id: string (UUID v4) — populated only when screening_trigger = amendment
payload_schema.beneficiary_name: string — full legal name for sanctions matching
payload_schema.hs_tariff_codes: array of string — 6-digit HS codes for dual-use / export control screening
payload_schema.goods_description: string — free-text goods description for TBML typology assessment

consumers.action: Screens beneficiary name/country against OFSI consolidated list, HM Treasury financial sanctions, UN Security Council sanctions, OFAC SDN list. Screens HS tariff codes against UK Strategic Export Controls dual-use goods database (Export Control Order 2008). Assesses TBML red flags. Publishes EVT-077 (LCComplianceCleared) if all clear, or raises internal compliance alert if hit detected.
WORM audit record of compliance screening request with full screening payload. OFSI regulatory evidence.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-LC strict ordering via lc_id partition key on topic compliance.sanctions-screening. screening_request_id used for correlation with EVT-077 response.
events.worm_rationale: Contains beneficiary PII and sanctions screening payload. OFSI regulations require evidence that screening was performed before LC issuance. POCA 2002 / MLR 2017 audit obligation. 7-year retention.

events.name: LCComplianceCleared
events.trigger: SVC-051 completes sanctions screening on EVT-076 payload. All screens return CLEAR: OFSI list clear, OFAC SDN clear, UN consolidated list clear, HS code dual-use check clear, TBML typology assessment below threshold. SVC-051 publishes EVT-077. SVC-006 gates LC issuance on receipt of this event — LetterOfCredit.compliance_status transitions from screening_requested to cleared.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-051). Consumed by CAP-002 (SVC-006). Crosses the CAP-005 / CAP-002 capability boundary. This is the clearance gate event — SVC-006 will not proceed to LC issuance without receiving this event.

payload_schema.screening_result: string — always 'clear' in this event (hit events use separate internal compliance alert, not this event)
payload_schema.tbml_risk_indicator: string enum (low | medium) — high indicator triggers internal hold, not this event
payload_schema.screening_reference: string — SVC-051 internal screening case reference for audit trail

consumers.action: Gates LC issuance. On receipt: LetterOfCredit.compliance_status = cleared; LetterOfCredit.compliance_cleared_at populated. Proceeds to PH-055 (LC Issuance). Idempotent on screening_request_id.
WORM audit record confirming compliance clearance with screening reference. OFSI evidence that screening was performed and cleared before LC issuance.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-LC strict ordering via lc_id partition key on topic compliance.sanctions-screening. Consumers must correlate with screening_request_id to match EVT-076/EVT-077 pairs.
events.worm_rationale: OFSI compliance clearance is a regulatory obligation. The clearing event must be immutably recorded as evidence that sanctions screening was performed before LC issuance. 7-year retention.

events.name: LCIssued
events.trigger: PH-055: SVC-006 has formatted the LC terms and triggered transmission. For SWIFT LCs: SWIFT MT700 transmitted to advising bank via SVC-010. For ETDA-compliant e-LCs: electronic LC issued via digital trade document platform. LetterOfCredit.status = issued, swift_reference and issue_date populated. EVT-078 is published after successful issuance confirmation.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-006). Consumed by CAP-003 (SVC-010) to trigger SWIFT MT700 transmission. Also consumed by SVC-053 (notification) and SVC-103 (audit). Crosses CAP-002 → CAP-003 boundary via async event — SVC-006 never calls SVC-010 synchronously.

payload_schema.etda_platform_reference: string — electronic trade document platform reference if issuance_channel = etda_electronic_platform

consumers.action: Receives EVT-078 and transmits SWIFT MT700 (Issue of Documentary Credit) to advising bank SWIFT BIC. Confirms transmission via delivery receipt. If issuance_channel = etda_electronic_platform, SVC-010 transmits supplementary SWIFT MT710 notification to advising bank only.
Sends LC issuance confirmation to PER-002 (applicant) with LC reference, terms summary, and expiry date.
WORM audit record of LC issuance. Regulatory evidence of date and terms of issuance.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-LC strict ordering via lc_id partition key on topic commercial.trade-finance. SVC-010 must process at-least-once with deduplication on lc_id + issue_date.
events.worm_rationale: LC issuance is an irrevocable payment undertaking — a legal and regulatory event. Immutable audit evidence required for UCP 600 compliance, dispute resolution, and FCA record-keeping. 7-year retention.

events.name: DocumentPresented
events.trigger: PH-056: SVC-006 receives and logs a document presentation under an issued LC — either via physical receipt (Trade Finance Operations), SWIFT MT750 forwarding from presenting bank, or ETDA e-presentation. TradeDocument (ENT-038) is created. The 5-banking-day UCP 600 examination clock starts. EVT-079 is published.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-006). Consumed within CAP-002 for examination workflow. Also consumed by SVC-053 (notification to Trade Finance Operations) and SVC-103 (audit). No cross-capability consumers in the happy path.

payload_schema.presentation_deadline: string (ISO 8601 date) — UCP 600 Article 14(c) calculated deadline
payload_schema.document_types_received: array of string — list of document types included in presentation

consumers.action: Triggers examination workflow internally. Routes presentation to available trade finance examiner (PER-059). Creates DocumentExamination (ENT-039) shell. Starts 5-banking-day countdown timer with T+4 alert and T+4.5 escalation.
Notifies Trade Finance Operations team of new document presentation requiring examination.
WORM audit record of document receipt. Regulatory evidence of presentation date for UCP 600 Article 14(b) examination period calculation.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-LC strict ordering via lc_id partition key on topic commercial.trade-finance.
events.worm_rationale: Document presentation date establishes the 5-banking-day examination deadline — a hard regulatory obligation under UCP 600 Article 14(b). Immutable record required. 7-year retention.

events.name: DocumentExamined
events.trigger: PH-057: Trade Finance Operations (PER-059) completes examination of presented documents within the UCP 600 5-banking-day period. DocumentExamination.examination_result is set to compliant, discrepant, or deadline_missed. EVT-080 is published. This event gates settlement (compliant or waived discrepant) vs refusal.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-006). Consumed within CAP-002 to drive settlement or refusal flow. SVC-053 for customer notification. SVC-103 for WORM audit (examination result is a critical regulatory record).

payload_schema.discrepancy_codes: array of string — discrepancy reference codes if result = discrepant (e.g. D001-LATE-SHIPMENT, D002-INVOICE-MISMATCH); empty array if compliant
payload_schema.drawing_amount: decimal — amount to be settled if compliant

consumers.action: Routes to settlement flow (PH-058) if examination_result = compliant. Routes to discrepancy management if = discrepant. Triggers compliance incident if = deadline_missed (UCP 600 Article 16(f) preclusion).

If compliant: notifies applicant that documents have been accepted and settlement will follow. If discrepant: notifies applicant of specific discrepancies and requests waiver instruction within deadline.
WORM audit record of examination result. Critical regulatory evidence for UCP 600 compliance and potential ICC Banking Commission disputes. 7-year retention.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-LC strict ordering via lc_id partition key on topic commercial.trade-finance. Consumers must process at-least-once with deduplication on examination_id.
events.worm_rationale: Document examination result determines whether the bank honours its payment undertaking. Immutable regulatory evidence for UCP 600 compliance, dispute resolution under ICC Banking Commission arbitration, and FCA record-keeping. 7-year retention.

events.name: LCSettled
events.trigger: PH-058: SVC-006 has completed settlement — applicant BusinessAccount debited (via SVC-005 same-capability call confirmed), SWIFT reimbursement instruction sent to SVC-010 (CAP-003) via async event. LetterOfCredit.status = settled. EVT-081 published.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-006). Consumed by CAP-003 (SVC-010) to trigger SWIFT MT202 reimbursement. Also consumed by SVC-053, SVC-103. Crosses CAP-002 → CAP-003 boundary.

payload_schema.usance_maturity_date: string (ISO 8601 date) — null for sight payments

consumers.action: Receives EVT-081 and transmits SWIFT MT202 (General Financial Institution Transfer) or SWIFT MT910 reimbursement instruction to advising/reimbursing bank for payment to beneficiary. Confirms SWIFT delivery.
Sends settlement confirmation to PER-002 (applicant) confirming payment and debit amount.
WORM audit record of settlement. Regulatory evidence that the bank honoured its UCP 600 payment undertaking.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-LC strict ordering via lc_id partition key on topic commercial.trade-finance. SVC-010 must process at-least-once with deduplication on lc_id + settlement_date + settlement_amount.
events.worm_rationale: LC settlement is the bank's fulfilment of its irrevocable payment undertaking — a legally and regulatorily significant event. Immutable audit evidence required. 7-year retention.

events.name: LCExpired
events.trigger: EXC-002: The LC expiry_date has passed without a compliant document presentation being received. SVC-006 scheduled job runs nightly to detect expired LCs. LetterOfCredit.status transitions to expired. EVT-082 is published. Any blocked facility headroom is released back to the customer's credit limit.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-002 (SVC-006). Consumed within CAP-002 by SVC-005 to release facility headroom. Also consumed by SVC-053 for applicant notification and SVC-103 for audit.

payload_schema.lc_amount: decimal — face value of expired LC (used to release facility headroom)
payload_schema.presentation_received: boolean — always false in this event

consumers.action: Releases the lc_amount from the blocked facility headroom, restoring it to the customer's available trade finance limit. Updates BusinessCustomer.active_lc_count.
Notifies PER-002 that LC has expired without a drawing, and confirms the facility headroom has been released.
WORM audit record of LC expiry — off-balance-sheet commitment termination. Required for Basel 3.1 capital reporting (contingent exposure reversal).

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-LC strict ordering via lc_id partition key on topic commercial.trade-finance.
events.worm_rationale: LC expiry terminates the bank's payment undertaking and reverses the off-balance-sheet capital commitment. Regulatory evidence required for Basel 3.1 RWA reporting and FCA record-keeping. 7-year retention.
